## Micro-tools shipped
- [Scrapely](https://scrapely-ai.vercel.app/) — Turn any webpage into clean JSON with AI-assisted extraction.
- [Screenshot Studio](https://screen-shot-studio.vercel.app/) — Device-framed screenshots of any URL for design reviews.
- [ImageSqueeze](https://image-squeeze-lite.vercel.app/) — Privacy-first, in-browser JPEG/PNG/WebP compression.
- [Pocket QR](https://pocket-qr-vision.vercel.app/) — Generate and scan QR codes from the browser, no install.
